title: Yeah, But: Tough Cases and Putting It All Together
heading: Chapter 10
chapterLocalFacts: The chapter covers tough cases such as non-engagement, topic shifting, chronic complaining, power asymmetry, text-based conflict, and identity difference.
The framework does not change in tough cases; the order and emphasis change.
The underlying move remains restore safety and then speak honestly.
The closing warning is that the framework fails when used to manipulate or win instead of staying open to being changed.
bridgeForward: This is the final chapter and it closes by asking the reader to plan and have one or two real avoided conversations.

quoteLedger.text: The words are just the scaffolding.
